package.name: tf2_types
package.description:
Header-only library providing ROS-agnostic tf2 types.
Includes: - tf2::Quaternion, tf2::Vector3, tf2::Transform, tf2::Matrix3x3 (from Bullet LinearMath) - tf2::TimePoint, tf2::Duration (std::chrono based)
This package has ZERO runtime dependencies and can be used without any ROS infrastructure.
